decision: Do not substitute the existing dense-search atoms into the source-faithful lifecycle. Expose reusable fitted search and query operations preserving the retained backend behavior; keep layer partitioning, coordinate transforms and identifier mapping in the recipe.
limitations: Synthetic numeric inputs only. Differences establish non-equivalence, not that either implementation is mathematically invalid.
Unsorted radius results and k-neighbor ties are backend-dependent. No arbitrary-platform stable ordering is claimed.
Exact floating-point and ordering differences require full downstream lifecycle comparison before substitution.
This review neither publishes providers nor approves the original CDG.
